purpose: Numerical recovery after final-comparison SARIMAX fits fail the locked L-BFGS retry policy; no model or information-set change
defined_after: Weeks 2 and 17 failed; both L-BFGS retries reported zero iterations. No failed-fit forecast was scored.
scope: Failed core or controlled-ablation SARIMAX fits with the validation-selected orders. Preserve original failures. Do not reopen validation-based configuration selection or choose a solver by test error. Ablation recovery coverage was included before sensitivity results were available.
initial_parameters: Failed fit's finite parameter vector, in model.param_names order
acceptance: Final L-BFGS convergence, finite log likelihood and parameter vector, training likelihood no worse than the failed starting point (1e-5 numeric tolerance), and 168 finite correctly aligned predictions. Otherwise preserve unresolved failure.
resource_accounting: Report both the original failed attempt and recovery effort; never label reused or recovered fit time as a fresh uninterrupted fit.
interpretation: This is a recorded numerical-policy amendment after convergence failures. It changes solver initialization, not selected forecasting model settings. Any recovered coverage must be labeled transparently.
